themes_detail.label: Illegal Fireworks Surge
themes_detail.summary: Illegal fireworks complaints exploded to 21 this week versus 0.8 weekly average over the prior 8 weeks—a 2,700% spike (z-score: 24.42)—suggesting either organized activity, a specific event, or a sudden enforcement gap in Bay Ridge/Dyker Heights.
evidence: 21 illegal fireworks complaints THIS WEEK vs. 0.8 weekly average over prior 8 weeks
Z-score of 24.42 indicates extreme statistical anomaly
reporting_angles: Interview residents in affected blocks to map when/where fireworks are occurring and whether they're organized or random
Contact NYPD about enforcement response and any enforcement gaps or known organized activity

themes_detail.label: Electrical System Failures
themes_detail.summary: Electric complaints spiked to 14 THIS WEEK versus 3.9 weekly average over the prior 8 weeks—a 261% increase (z-score: 5.99)—indicating potential grid stress, aging infrastructure, or widespread wiring issues affecting multiple buildings or blocks.
evidence: 14 electrical complaints THIS WEEK vs. 3.9 weekly average over prior 8 weeks
Z-score of 5.99 indicates statistically significant spike
reporting_angles: Query Con Edison about recent outages, maintenance work, or infrastructure upgrades in Bay Ridge/Dyker Heights
Identify geographic clusters of complaints to determine if issue is neighborhood-wide or block-specific

themes_detail.label: Dead Animal Collection Crisis
themes_detail.summary: Dead animal complaints surged to 13 THIS WEEK versus 2.0 weekly average over the prior 8 weeks—a 550% spike (z-score: 4.49)—raising public health and sanitation concerns about disease vectors or lack of timely removal.
evidence: 13 dead animal complaints THIS WEEK vs. 2.0 weekly average over prior 8 weeks
Z-score of 4.49 indicates statistically significant anomaly
reporting_angles: Contact NYC Department of Sanitation about removal response times and any backlog or staffing issues
Investigate potential disease outbreak or environmental trigger (e.g., pest infestation, food source availability, seasonal migration)

themes_detail.label: Noise Complaints Climbing
themes_detail.summary: Noise complaints jumped to 27 THIS WEEK versus 11.6 weekly average over the prior 8 weeks—a 132% increase (z-score: 4.75)—suggesting either construction activity, new businesses, or event-related disturbances.
evidence: 27 noise complaints THIS WEEK vs. 11.6 weekly average over prior 8 weeks
Z-score of 4.75 indicates statistically significant spike
reporting_angles: Map noise complaints geographically to identify hotspots and determine source (construction, bars, events, traffic)
Cross-reference with DOB permits data to identify any active construction projects that may be driving complaints

themes_detail.label: Park Safety & Rules Violations
themes_detail.summary: Park-related complaints accelerated over the past 2 weeks: park rules violations spiked to 6 last week (586% above 8-week average, z-score 6.57) and animals in parks surged 3 complaints 2 weeks ago (700% above average, z-score 5.42), suggesting either new animal activity or increased enforcement/reporting.
evidence: 6 park rules violations last week vs. 0.9 weekly average over prior 8 weeks (586% increase, z-score 6.57)
3 animal-in-park complaints 2 weeks ago vs. 0.4 weekly average over prior 8 weeks (700% increase, z-score 5.42)
Convergence of two park-related spikes suggests systematic issue
reporting_angles: Contact NYC Parks about recent wildlife activity, nesting, or population changes in Bay Ridge/Dyker Heights parks
Interview park users and NYC Parks rangers about what rule violations are being reported and whether there's a specific hot spot
